dex.entry: The water-sprite is now a swift silver shape that dances between moonbeams, spreading brief distraction-glimmers to cover allies. The support speedster that doubles as a gorgeous visual — its moonveil makes other kin look good.

art.silhouette: Slim, elegant aquatic sprite — silver with pale moonlight-blue highlights, long streaming water-veil wings, a crescent-shaped luminous head-marking, twin ribbon tails.
